title: ID verification giant IDScan confirms data breach with more than 150 million driver's licenses stolen | TechCrunch
summary: The company said in a website notice that hackers stole the driver’s licenses from the company’s cloud; the stolen information includes people’s full names and driver’s license numbers, along with identity numbers from other government-issued documents, such as passports.
